title: TSD Daily — Saturday, August 29, 2026
summary: An Anthropic automated researcher beat human researchers on ten alignment benchmarks at four dollars an hour, Claude became the default model in Slack, two men were charged over the Shai-Hulud worm that poisoned Trivy and LiteLLM, Nvidia reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face for 12.9 billion, and Warsh told Jackson Hole the Fed may need to raise rates.
